intent: Specify the public API of the `datealgo` crate (low-level proleptic Gregorian calendar algorithms): `is_leap_year`, `days_in_month`, `date_to_rd`, `rd_to_date`, `rd_to_weekday`, `date_to_weekday`, `next_date`, `prev_date`, `secs_to_dhms`, `dhms_to_secs`, `secs_to_datetime`, `datetime_to_secs`, `rd_to_isoweekdate`, `isoweekdate_to_rd`, `date_to_isoweekdate`, `isoweekdate_to_date`, `isoweeks_in_year`, and the public range constants `YEAR_MIN`, `YEAR_MAX`, `RD_MIN`, `RD_MAX`, `RD_SECONDS_MIN`, `RD_SECONDS_MAX`. In Lean they live in namespace `datealgo` (e.g. `datealgo.date_to_rd (y, m, d)` with `y : Std.I32`, `m d : Std.U8`); tuple arguments and results are Lean products, and `RD_MIN` etc. are `RustM` values.

manual_mutants.note: century test uses divisibility by 200 instead of 400 (2200 becomes a leap year)
month upper bound not checked: month 13.. returns a garbage length instead of panicking
next_date of the last supported date silently returns a year beyond YEAR_MAX
January 1st steps back to December 30th of the previous year
seconds above RD_SECONDS_MAX are clamped to 0 instead of panicking
day above RD_MAX silently yields 0 seconds instead of panicking
every year starting on a Wednesday gets 53 ISO weeks (leap-year condition forgotten)
week number counted from the given day instead of that week's Thursday: early-January days of week 1 (Mon-Wed before Jan 1) and some late-December days get the wrong week

sibling_mutants.after: massert (y >= YEAR_MIN ∧ y <= YEAR_MAX ∧ m >= consts.MONTH_MIN)
sibling_mutants.note: days_in_month also debug-asserts the documented year range for every month (upstream only checks it via is_leap_year in February)

bug_variants.note: before the fix isoweekdate_to_rd accepted Friday..Sunday of ISO week 53 of YEAR_MAX and returned a Rata Die above RD_MAX (isoweekdate_to_date then panics in rd_to_date); every in-range ISO week date must map into [RD_MIN, RD_MAX] and out-of-range arguments must panic

edits.with_text:
def isoweekdate_to_rd (t : (Std.I32 × Std.U8 × Std.U8)) : RustM Std.I32 := do
  let (y, w, d) := t
  massert (y >= YEAR_MIN)
  massert (y <= YEAR_MAX)
  massert (w >= consts.WEEK_MIN)
  let i ← isoweeks_in_year y
  massert (w <= i)
  massert (d >= consts.WEEKDAY_MIN)
  massert (d <= consts.WEEKDAY_MAX)
  let rd4 ← date_to_rd (y, 1#u8, 4#u8)
  let wd4 ← rd_to_weekday rd4
  let i1 ← wd4 - 1#u8
  let i2 ← lift (UScalar.hcast .I32 i1)
  let ys ← rd4 - i2
  let i3 ← lift (UScalar.hcast .I32 w)
  let i4 ← i3 - 1#i32
  let i5 ← i4 * 7#i32
  let i6 ← ys + i5
  let i7 ← lift (UScalar.hcast .I32 d)
  let i8 ← i7 - 1#i32
  i6 + i8

bug_variants.note: Julian leap rule: is_leap_year treats every year divisible by 4 as leap (1900, 2100 become leap years), contradicting the documented proleptic Gregorian calendar
